outcome: Explore reveals the top card: a land goes to hand, otherwise the permanent gets a +1/+1 counter and the card may go to the graveyard.
A permanent explores, firing explore triggers, even if some of the actions were impossible.
A permanent that left the battlefield still explores, using last known information for the object and its controller.
Simultaneous explores happen one at a time, in APNAP order of the permanents' controllers.
